summary.summary: You were in the hospital for a weak heart and lung infection. Your heart was not pumping well and fluid built up in your lungs and legs. You also had a mild kidney injury that got better. Some of your medicines were changed to help your heart and kidneys. The most important thing to do at home is weigh yourself every morning and call your care team if your weight goes up fast.

diagnoses.plain: Weak heart that does not pump well (ejection fraction 30%)
Lung infection in the lower right lung
Mild kidney injury that got better

new.name: Furosemide
new.why: To remove extra fluid from your body (volume management)

new.name: Losartan
new.why: To help your heart and lower your blood pressure

new.name: Empagliflozin
new.why: To help your heart and manage your blood sugar

new.name: Amoxicillin-clavulanate
new.howOften: twice a day by mouth for 3 more days
new.why: To finish treating your lung infection (pneumonia)

continue.name: Metoprolol succinate
continue.why: To help your heart beat in a steady, healthy way

continue.name: Apixaban
continue.why: To prevent blood clots because of your irregular heartbeat

continue.name: Atorvastatin
continue.why: To keep your cholesterol at a healthy level

continue.name: Metformin
continue.why: To manage your blood sugar — only if your kidney function stays stable

stop.name: Lisinopril
stop.why: Stopped because your medicine was changed to Losartan

stop.name: Spironolactone
stop.why: On hold until your doctor checks your kidney function and potassium levels

stop.name: Ibuprofen/other NSAIDs
stop.why: Do not take these pain relievers — they can make heart failure and kidney problems worse

checklist.text: Take Furosemide 40 mg every morning by mouth
Take Losartan 25 mg every morning by mouth
Take Empagliflozin 10 mg every morning by mouth
Take Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125 mg twice a day — finish all 3 days even if you feel better
checklist.due: twice a day for 3 more days

checklist.text: Take Metoprolol succinate 50 mg once a day
Take Apixaban 5 mg twice a day
Take Metformin 500 mg twice a day (only if kidneys stay stable)
Weigh yourself at the same time every morning and write it down
Keep a written record of your weight and any new symptoms
Get a basic metabolic panel blood test (checks kidneys and potassium)
checklist.due: before or at your first follow-up visit within 1 week

checklist.text: See your primary care doctor for a follow-up visit
See your heart doctor (cardiologist) for a follow-up visit
Eat a low-salt diet — aim for no more than 2 grams of sodium a day
Follow the fluid limits your heart-failure team gave you
Do not take ibuprofen or any other NSAIDs (pain relievers like Advil or Aleve)

goToER: New or worsening shortness of breath, especially at rest
Rapidly worsening swelling in your legs or belly
callClinic: Your weight goes up fast — follow the weight-action plan your heart-failure team gave you
Worsening swelling or breathlessness that is not an emergency
Fever or worsening cough even while taking antibiotics
Any signs of unusual bleeding (because you take apixaban, a blood thinner)

followUps.why: To check how you are doing after leaving the hospital
To review your heart function and adjust your heart medicines

followUps.when: Within about 1 week (before or at the visit)
followUps.why: To check your kidney function and potassium level with a blood test

questionsToAsk: At what weight gain should I call the clinic versus go to the emergency room?
When will you decide if it is safe to restart Spironolactone?
Are there any signs of bleeding I should watch for while taking Apixaban?
How will you know if my kidneys are stable enough to keep taking Metformin?
Is there anything specific I should do if I miss a dose of Furosemide or Losartan?

translation.summary: Usted estuvo en el hospital por un corazón débil y una infección en los pulmones. Su corazón no bombeaba bien y se acumuló líquido en los pulmones y las piernas. También tuvo una lesión leve en los riñones que mejoró. Se cambiaron algunos de sus medicamentos para ayudar al corazón y los riñones. Lo más importante que debe hacer en casa es pesarse cada mañana y llamar a su equipo de salud si su peso sube rápido.

new.name: Furosemide
new.howOften: una vez al día por la boca
new.why: Para eliminar el exceso de líquido de su cuerpo (control de volumen)

new.name: Losartan
new.howOften: una vez al día por la boca
new.why: Para ayudar a su corazón y bajar su presión arterial

new.name: Empagliflozin
new.howOften: una vez al día por la boca
new.why: Para ayudar a su corazón y controlar su azúcar en la sangre

new.name: Amoxicillin-clavulanate
new.howOften: dos veces al día por la boca durante 3 días más
new.why: Para terminar el tratamiento de su infección pulmonar (neumonía)

continue.name: Metoprolol succinate
continue.why: Para ayudar a que su corazón lata de manera estable y saludable

continue.name: Apixaban
continue.why: Para prevenir coágulos de sangre debido a su latido irregular del corazón

continue.name: Atorvastatin
continue.why: Para mantener su colesterol en un nivel saludable

continue.name: Metformin
continue.why: Para controlar su azúcar en la sangre — solo si la función de sus riñones se mantiene estable

stop.name: Lisinopril
stop.why: Se suspendió porque su medicamento fue cambiado a Losartan

stop.name: Spironolactone
stop.why: En pausa hasta que su médico revise la función de sus riñones y sus niveles de potasio

stop.name: Ibuprofen/other NSAIDs
stop.why: No tome estos analgésicos — pueden empeorar la insuficiencia cardíaca y los problemas de riñón
